prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent animation sprite sheet for a tiny 2D rooftop endless runner.
Primary request: Turn the bandana-wearing stuntman in reference 1 into a SMALL crisp side-view pixel-art running character suitable for Canabalt's minimalist gray city. Keep his recognizable red bandana with TWO streaming tails, short dark hair, sleeveless dark vest, light gray exposed arms, charcoal combat trousers and boots. No weapon, harness, grenades, or backpack. All body colors are neutral grayscale except the muted crimson bandana. Reference 2 is the tonal simplicity of the rooftop world; do not copy its character or buildings.
Style: precise retro PIXEL ART with deliberately LARGE clear square pixel clusters, limited 6-shade grayscale palette plus dark red cloth, hard silhouette. Clean compact athletic proportions, readable small hands and boots, expressive strong forward lean. Designed to read at 24 pixels tall in the game. NOT a stickman, not a huge muscular portrait, no detailed painterly rendering. No smooth 3D, no soft outlines. Single pixel-art light-gray rim on top of hair/shoulder helps read against darker buildings.
Layout: exactly 1536x1024 PNG, GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows. Each of the 12 cells is 384x341 pixels. Keep ALL pixels inside a generous 40px clear margin in each cell. No grid or labels. Each character is approximately 160px wide and 220px tall, anchored feet at y=290 in its cell, body center x=192, consistent proportions and head size throughout.
Cells 1-8 (first two rows) are eight sequential SIDE-VIEW RUN-CYCLE frames FACING RIGHT, the same character with alternating legs reaching, contact, compression, passing, opposite reaching, contact, compression, passing. The arms counter-swing naturally. Red cloth tails trail LEFT. Head and body remain consistent across frames.
Cell 9 (bottom left): ascending jump, right knee lifted forward, trailing leg back, arms bent.
Cell 10: falling from helicopter, knees bent and hands braced forward, red ribbons trailing upward/left.
Cell 11: compact TUCKED FORWARD ROLL, head down at right, back rounded, knees tucked tightly to chest; low circular silhouette with both ribbons attached.
Cell 12: low landing CROUCH preparing to sprint, one knee under body, one hand touching rooftop (no actual ground drawn).
All poses face RIGHT, body continues same outfit and grayscale shading. True transparent empty pixels around and between limbs, no shadows, no ground, no scenery, no words.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: image 1, the 12-frame grayscale bandana runner atlas.
Reference image 2: original Contra running animation, for pose and rhythm ONLY. Reference its high knee lift, planted boots, compact forward-leaning torso, and stable TWO-HANDED FORWARD RIFLE hold while legs cycle.
Primary request: Change this runner to carry a LARGE MACHINE GUN like a Contra commando, IN EVERY FRAME. Preserve all 12 frame cells in exactly the same 1536x1024 atlas layout, character identity, grayscale body palette, red headband and TWO streaming red ribbon tails, clear pixel art and transparency.
For the eight RUN frames (top two rows), replace the free swinging arms with BOTH hands holding one clearly visible long dark machine gun pointing horizontally RIGHT from chest/waist height. Stock tucked into shoulder, near hand on trigger, far hand supports barrel foregrip. Both elbows bend. The long barrel protrudes in FRONT OF HIS BODY by about one head width. Silver top edge, black muzzle, visible chunky magazine beneath the middle. No firing, no muzzle flash. Keep muzzle at the SAME relative height across all run frames, upper torso stable with only slight vertical bob. Legs cycle through wide Contra-style strides and bent-knee passing poses, boots kicking back. He runs armed and ready, not aiming down and not casually holding a tiny pistol.
For the jump and falling frames (bottom cells 1 and 2), keep the gun in both hands angled forward/slightly upward close to chest while knees bend. For the tucked roll (bottom cell 3), keep gun tucked tight alongside forearms. For the crouch (bottom cell 4), both hands hold the machine gun forward as he rises. Do not lose the gun during any pose.
Keep each sprite fully within its own cell with at least 24 pixels clear padding around the barrel, feet and ribbons. All sprites face RIGHT. Crisp limited-palette pixel clusters, compact natural body proportions, readable when body is downsampled to 26px tall. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background including spaces between limbs and gun, no backdrop or glow. Only the bandana is red; everything else neutral grayscale. No words, labels, particles, shadows, scenery or extra objects.
runtime: Eight armed run frames plus jump, fall, tuck and landing. All poses carry the machine gun; body stays 26 logical pixels tall. The first unarmed generated version is not bundled. Source image alpha preserved; crops in src/runner-assets.js.
